title: Senior Analyst Business Intelligence Data Analyst
description:
Introduction

Welcome to Gallagher - a global community of people who bring bold ideas, deep expertise, and a shared commitment to doing what s right.
We help clients navigate complexity with confidence by empowering businesses, communities, and individuals to thrive.
At Gallagher, you ll find more than a job; you ll find a culture built on trust, driven by collaboration, and sustained by the belief that we re better together. Experience a workplace where you re encouraged to be yourself, supported to succeed, and inspired to keep learning. That s what it means to live The Gallagher Way.
Founded in 2006, the Gallagher Center of Excellence (GCoE) upholds the values of quality, innovation, and teamwork. With 10,000+ professionals across five India locations, GCoE is where knowledge-driven individuals make a significant impact and build rewarding, long-term careers.

Overview

Gallagher Center of Excellence is seeking to hire a Data Analytics professional for the GCoE Business Enablement vertical.
You will be responsible for analyzing complex data sets to provide actionable insights that drive business decisions.
You will manage the collection, processing, and analysis of data to support strategic initiatives and improve operational efficiency.
We are looking for someone who is very strong in MS Excel and Access, possesses good communication skills, and has a keen attention to detail.
Exposure to advanced analytics tools, data visualization techniques, and predictive modeling is a definite plus.
Your role will involve driving data excellence and innovation.
Additionally, you will be responsible for fostering a culture of collaboration, continuous improvement, and customer focus within the analytics team.
You will interact with team members located in various regions across the globe.
This position offers an exciting opportunity to fast track your learning and to build understanding of a wide range of sectors, at pace and with lots of variety.
Working alongside highly experienced reward consultants, the role offers much greater opportunities for rich and diverse learning and professional development than is available in most in-house roles, equipping you for the future while also honing your client engagement skills.

How youll make an impact

Responsibilities:
Research and Analysis:
Researching data sources, market practice and other benchmarking information from published salary surveys through to internet searches.
Data analysis (primarily Excel based), including interpreting results and developing recommendations across pay benchmarking, gender pay gap reporting and equal pay auditing.
Data insight translating data into valued findings and understandable information, which is accessible and useful to clients.
Effective presentation of findings - formatting data into clear, accessible graphs, tables and infographics.
Development and Design:
Providing input and evidence based advice in the development of pay progression systems and pay structures.
Cost modelling of different scenarios and similar impact assessments
Drafting documents in Excel, Word or PowerPoint to present options and recommendations to
clients.
Survey Management:
Gallagher runs a high quality UK benefits survey, which is published annually in October (250 participant organisations submitted data in 2019) and the job holder plays an important role in shaping design and continuous improvement of the survey, as well as encouraging participation.
Survey co-ordination receiving, cleansing and checking inbound data and referring queries back to clients
Survey analyses - establishing findings, trend data and other insights and thereafter working with colleagues in Gallagher Communications to present those findings in a visual and impactful manner.
Survey development helping design new surveys as well as supporting the growth of existing surveys.
Analysis of our annual Employee Communication Survey for Global Communication.
Supporting the build and analysis of employee communication survey.
Client Interaction:
Although the role will be primarily office based, there will be opportunities to attend client meetings,typically accompanied by a Senior Consultant, to:
Take the brief for a client or prospect s consultancy requirements
Obtain the views of key stakeholders within the organisation e.g. in running focus groups
Writing or helping with the preparation of proposals for client work (either following a preliminary meeting or telephone and email contact with the client or in response to an invitation to tender)
Managing small benchmarking projects alone, albeit drawing on the close support of Consultants and Senior Consultants, as required.
Most small projects will be for new or existing clients and usually confined to telephone and/or email based contact with the client.
Reward Consulting team:
Supporting with Gender Pay Gap analysis and reporting for clients - this ranges from basic reports to deep dive analysis
Support with Pay Transparency projects which will also need some analytical support
Setting up spreadsheets for pay benchmarking and pay structures projects
Creating client facing calculation tools for variable pay projects
Analysis of the annual National Benchmarking Survey for the UK
EVP team:
Data Collection & Integration - Aggregate and clean data from multiple sources (HRIS, engagement surveys, compensation databases, external benchmarks).
Analytics & Modelling Build/Review statistical models (e.g., regression, attrition prediction) to identify drivers of promotions, exits, and engagement ; Develop/review dashboards in tools like Power BI for real-time insights on attraction, retention, and workforce segmentation.
Reporting & Visualisation - Create clear, compelling reports and visualisations, including persona-based insights and EVP impact metrics.
Competencies:
Analytical Thinking: Ability to systematically and logically break down complex data sets to extract
actionable insights and inform business decisions.
Attention to Detail: Strong focus on accuracy and thoroughness in reviewing data submissions,
identifying discrepancies, and maintaining organized records
Communication Skills: Proficient in conveying information clearly and effectively to clients and team
members, ensuring mutual understanding and timely data
Technical Proficiency: Expertise in using MS Excel and Access for data entry, analysis, and database
management, with a willingness to learn additional analytics tools
Problem-Solving: Capability to identify issues within data sets and implement effective solutions
to resolve discrepancies and improve data processes.
Collaboration: Ability to work effectively with team members and departments to achieve
common goals and ensure seamless data management
Process Improvement: Aptitude for identifying opportunities to enhance data accuracy and efficiency
and implementing innovative solutions.
Adaptability: Flexibility to adjust to changing priorities and new challenges in a dynamic
work environment.
Organizational Skills: Strong ability to manage multiple tasks and priorities, maintaining organized
and up-to-date records and documentation.

About you

Qualifications:
Minimum Required Degree: Bachelors degree in a relevant field such as Data Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related discipline.
Preferred Degree: Master s degree in data science, Statistics, Business Analytics, Computer Science, or a related field. Advanced degrees can provide deeper expertise and a competitive edge in the field.
Certificate(s)/Special Training:

Certified Analytics Professional (CAP): A widely recognized certification that demonstrates expertise in the analytics process.

Microsoft Certified: Data Analyst Associate: Validates skills in using MS Access, Power BI to maximize the value of data assets.

Google Data Analytics Professional Certificate: Provides foundational skills in data cleaning, analysis, and visualization.

Experience ( Career Level Guide)
6-9 years of experience in data analytics or a related field.
Proficiency in data analysis, statistical methods, and data visualization tools such as Tableau or Power BI.
Experience in managing databases and conducting complex data analyses.
Advanced expertise in data modeling, predictive analytics, and machine learning techniques.
Proven track record of leading data-driven projects and providing strategic insights to support business decisions.
Experience in managing teams, developing analytics strategies, and driving innovation in data processes.
Strong ability to communicate insights to executive stakeholders and influence decision-making.
Statistical methods and advanced analysis e.g. regression and key driver analysis would be beneficial.
Working with Databases and analysis specific packages such as R, SPSS, Python is added advantage.
Required Skills And Knowledge:
Proven experience of working as a Reward Analyst, as experience matters as much as the quality of your excel
and wider analytical skills
Highly developed MS Office IT skills, but especially advanced level Excel sufficient to manipulate data to
obtain impactful insights and trend analyses
Numerate, with high attention to detail and an aptitude for systems and data management
Administratively well organized, being a completer finisher with a considerable ability to prioritize tasks
Resilient attitude, i.e. not easily blown off course by unpredictable work flows or tight timescales/deadlines
A proactive can do attitude and a willingness to go the extra mile when required
An inquisitive nature - interested in learning about different sectors, with the tenacity to research and mine
data
A responsive, client focused approach and the empathy to see the world from the client s perspective
The interpersonal skills and ability to develop effective working relationships with clients and persuade
prospective clients to participate in our surveys
Mature judgement, i.e. having sufficiently reliable insight into people and the workings of large organizations
to know the right things to do and say
Good written and oral presentation skills, sufficient to turn data into meaningful, easily accessible information

Additional Information

Compensation and benefits
On top of a competitive salary, great teams and exciting career opportunities, we also offer a wide range of benefits.
Below are the minimum core benefits you ll get, depending on your job level, these benefits may improve:
Medical Insurance and Parental Medical Insurance
Accidental Insurance and Life Insurance
Retirals - Employee Gratuity, Future Service Gratuity benefit - Group Term Life, Employee Provident Fund, National Pension Scheme
Flexi Benefits Plan Tax Savings Plans
Annual Leave/ Maternity & Paternity Leave/ Additional paid ML, Mental Health Day
Other benefits include:
Employee Wellness Programs
Training programs
And more..
We value inclusion and diversity
Inclusion and diversity (I&D) is a core part of our business, and it s embedded into the fabric of our organization. For more than 95 years, Gallagher has led with a commitment to sustainability and to support the communities where we live and work.
Gallagher embraces our employees diverse identities, experiences and talents, allowing us to better serve our clients and communities. We see inclusion as a conscious commitment and diversity as a vital strength. By embracing diversity in all its forms, we live out The Gallagher Way to its fullest.
Equal employment opportunity will be extended in all aspects of the employer-employee relationship, including, but not limited to, recruitment, hiring, training, promotion, transfer, demotion, compensation, benefits, layoff, and termination.

description:
Description
The Opportunity:
Spiceworks is expanding its editorial team to help address a global audience of IT professionals with the career and tech advice they need to thrive in their careers. The Staff Editor, based in India, will have the opportunity to help shape and grow the content we offer to our audience.
The successful candidate is a self-starting, detail-oriented editor who will work closely with writers, editors, and leaders across the organization to ensure our brands publish work representative of our high standards. This person has experience overseeing and guiding writers, bringing out the best version of their work. They are also excellent writers themselves, who are willing to pitch in to write and update as needed. They partner well with others and are adept at collaborating with colleagues and leaders across time zones.
To support real-time publishing and cross-functional coordination, this role involves collaboration with U.S.-based teams, with some flexibility required for sync hours and shared planning.
This role requires original, human-generated work at all times. The use of any form of generative artificial intelligence (including but not limited to ChatGPT, Bard, Jasper, or other AI content or code generators) is strictly prohibited in the execution of job responsibilities. Any use of AI tools whether for content creation, code generation, communication, data analysis, or other task execution will be considered a serious violation of company policy.
Violation of this policy will result in immediate termination of employment
Key Responsibilities:
Identify opportunity. You will carefully edit and examine all assigned work to ensure editorial best practices are being followed, looking for all avenues for adding value before publishing.
Demonstrate organization. Coordinate closely with the Editor in Chief and the rest of the Spiceworks content team to ensure current priorities are being supported, and all work is correctly documented, within our internal tools.
Think critically. As a key person who will oversee work, it s crucial that you re a critical thinker who can sniff out and escalate potential issues, make suggestions, quickly adopt learnings, and follow-up with team members and leaders.
Communicate effectively. Ensure writers you work with are regularly reminded of best practices and work closely with your lead to identify any opportunities for growth and improvement among the writers you regularly work with.
Provide feedback. Track repeat errors and communicate up to your lead, ensuring any additional training or corrective measures can be delivered in a timely manner.
Stay organized. Work with writers to establish clear writing and update strategies for all forms of published work, while maintaining a flexible production calendar with your lead that adapts to current priorities.
Write content as needed. An excellent editor is also an excellent writer. This person not only helps others copy shine; they also roll up their sleeves to help write content to meet team goals.
Job Qualifications:
2+ years of editing experience, preferably in a service journalism setting
Able to handle multiple projects with short deadlines
Comfortable getting into the weeds on topics you are not an expert in, to ensure submitted writing is accurate and authoritative
Willingness to occasionally work outside of standard hours to support business needs during major events
Familiarity with content management systems (WordPress ideally), and data organization and chart making tools (Infogram, etc.)

Its brands include IGN, Mashable, RetailMeNot, PCMag, Humble Bundle, Spiceworks, Ookla (Speedtest), RootMetrics, Everyday Health, BabyCenter, Moz, iContact and Vipre Security.

Spiceworks offers competitive salaries in addition to robust, health and wellness-focused benefits. We are committed to work-life balance with paid time off when you need it.

We offer Employee Resource Groups, company-sponsored events, and regular opportunities for professional growth through educational support, mentorship programs, and career development resources. title: Junior DFM Engineer
description:
A-THON ALL-TERRAIN | Junior DFM Engineer (Mechanical) Job Profile
India's Indigenous Tactical Mobility Pioneer
India's ONLY homegrown All-Terrain Vehicle technology company. Our mules have FAR EXCEEDED Defence TEC trials and real-world Army testing proving what Indian engineering can achieve.

IDDM Category | Most preferred under DAP 2020
Strategic Defence Collaborations: Army Technology Board + IIT Ropar + DRIF | Army Design Bureau + ARTPARK (IISc)
Platforms: ASHVA 4x4/6x6 | ADBHUTBoT | RAKSHAK defence-validated in extreme terrains.

We are building India's "BEYOND ROADS" defence ground mobility future.
JUNIOR DFM ENGINEER (MECHANICAL)
The Translation Workforce
Bridge Domain | Junior DFM Sub-Function
Indigenous Design, Development & Manufacturing for Tactical Mobility

Location: Bangarpet, Kolar, Karnataka
Positions: 4 (Four)
A MESSAGE TO PROSPECTIVE TRANSLATION WORKFORCE
"In a market where nothing existed before, discovery must be protected from efficiency."
You are considering a role at the heart of A-THON's transformation from mules to production. As Junior DFM Engineer, you are part of the Translation Workforce that executes the detailed work of converting innovative designs into manufacturable products.

THE WORKFORCE OPPORTUNITY
Senior engineers provide strategy. You provide execution. Four positions mean you are part of a team building A-THON's DFM capability.
YOUR MISSION: Learn rapidly, execute thoroughly, and grow into the next generation of DFM leaders.

WHY FOUR POSITIONS?
Multiple Platforms: ASHVA 4x4, ASHVA 6x6, ADBHUTBoT, RAKSHAK each platform needs DFM coverage
High Volume of Work: Thousands of drawings, hundreds of analyses, countless reviews senior engineers cannot do all detailed work
Subsystem Coverage: Chassis, suspension, powertrain, body, electrical different engineers can develop expertise in different areas
Learning Curve: Entry-level engineers need time to develop expertise multiple positions ensure continuity while individuals grow
Redundancy & Scale: Production ramp-up requires workforce capacity that cannot depend on single individuals
You are not alone. You are part of a team building India's indigenous tactical vehicle DFM capability.

PART I: THE BRIDGE DOMAIN: WHERE TRANSLATION HAPPENS
Understanding Your Position in A-THON's Architecture
The Junior DFM Engineer operates in the Bridge Domain as the execution workforce. While senior engineers provide strategy and oversight, you execute the detailed work that makes translation happen.
BRIDGE DOMAIN: YOU WORK HERE
Drawing Reviews
Tolerance Analysis Support
DFMEA Participation
Documentation Work
You learn from Discovery (R&D) experience You execute the translation work Your work enables Operations success
Junior vs Mid-Level vs Senior: Your Place in the Team
Junior DFM Engineer (YOU) — 3-5 years:
Focus: BREADTH across DFM
Work Mode: Assisted execution
Primary Mode: LEARNING & EXECUTING
Mid-Level Specialists — 5-10 years:
Focus: Depth in specialty (GD&T Specialist, Stack-up Engineer, DFMEA Lead)
Work Mode: Independent execution
Primary Mode: Executing & teaching
Senior/Lead Roles — 10-15+ years:
Focus: Strategy & leadership (DFM Lead, Principal TE)
Work Mode: Guidance & approval
Primary Mode: Teaching & deciding
Your role is to learn rapidly while executing thoroughly. Growth comes through contribution.

PART II: GOVERNANCE DOCTRINE: LEARNING UNDER GUIDANCE
Entry-Level Individual Contributor
As Junior DFM Engineer, you work under supervision of senior engineers. Your authority grows as your competence grows.
PRIMARY REPORT: DFM Lead
Day-to-Day: Work assignment and prioritization, performance feedback and coaching, career guidance and development, resource and schedule management.
TECHNICAL GUIDANCE: Principal TE, GD&T Specialist, DFMEA Lead
Tolerance analysis: Principal TE / Stack-up Engineer
GD&T application: GD&T Specialist
DFMEA participation: DFMEA Lead
Drawing reviews: Assigned senior engineer
YOU CAN DO (WITH REVIEW):
Execute drawing reviews (checklist-based)
Perform basic tolerance calculations
Participate in DFMEA sessions
Document meeting notes and actions
Update drawings per redlines
Maintain DFM documentation
Conduct basic CAD analysis
YOU CANNOT (ESCALATE):
Approve drawings (senior approval required)
Release documents without review
Make design decisions
Commit to customer/supplier
Override standards
Sign off on quality gates
Authority grows with demonstrated competence. Ask questions. Seek guidance. Deliver quality.

PART VII: COMPREHENSIVE FUNCTION INVENTORY (16 FUNCTIONS)
The Junior DFM Engineer role spans 16 functional areas with BREADTH across DFM rather than depth in any single specialty.
A. Core Execution Functions
1. Drawing Review Execution
Review drawings using DFM checklists
Identify basic DFM issues (sharp corners, thin walls, access problems)
Document review findings for senior review
Verify drawing format compliance and check BOM-drawing alignment
Flag unclear or missing dimensions
2. Drawing Updates & Corrections
Update drawings per redline markups
Make corrections as directed by senior engineers
Maintain drawing revision history
Ensure CAD model-drawing consistency and route drawings for approval
3. Basic Tolerance Analysis
Perform simple 1D tolerance stack-ups
Create basic loop diagrams under guidance
Document tolerance calculation assumptions
Learn from senior engineers on complex stacks
4. GD&T Application Support
Apply basic GD&T per guidance (form tolerances)
Verify GD&T syntax correctness and datum reference consistency
Document GD&T questions for specialist review
5. DFMEA Session Participation
Participate actively in DFMEA sessions
Document failure modes and discussions, capture action items
Track countermeasure implementation status
6. BOM Verification Support
Verify BOM-drawing consistency
Check part number accuracy and validate material specifications
Document BOM discrepancies
7. CAD Model Review
Review CAD models for basic DFM issues
Check interference and clearance (basic)
Verify model-drawing consistency
8. Action Item Tracking
Maintain action item databases, track status and due dates
Follow up with owners on overdue items
Maintain meeting minutes and records

B. Learning & Support Functions
9. Mule Knowledge Capture
Document mule testing observations, interview R&D engineers on lessons learned
Build failure mode database from mule data
10. Supplier Interface Support
Review supplier drawings for basic issues
Track supplier deliverables, learn supplier capability assessment
11. DFM Checklist Development
Maintain and update DFM checklists, document new DFM issues discovered
12. Documentation Maintenance
Maintain DFM document library, ensure version control, support audit needs
13. Training Participation
Attend all DFM training sessions, complete GD&T certification, build CAD proficiency
14. Cross-Functional Exposure
Attend design reviews, shadow senior engineers, participate in shop floor activities
15. Quality Support
Support CMM data analysis, document inspection findings, learn SPC
16. PFMEA Support
Participate in PFMEA sessions, provide design knowledge to manufacturing

PART VIII: KEY RESPONSIBILITIES (WEIGHTED)
30% — Drawing Review & Updates
25% — DFMEA & Documentation Support
20% — Tolerance & GD&T Support
15% — Knowledge Capture & Learning
10% — Cross-Functional Support

PART IX: MANDATORY QUALIFICATIONS
Educational Requirements
Undergraduate: B.Tech/B.E. Mechanical Engineering (Required)
Postgraduate: Not required at entry level (M.Tech in Manufacturing/Design a plus)
Certifications: Basic GD&T training (Preferred), CAD certification (Preferred)

Experience Requirements
Total Experience: 3 years minimum (4-5 years ideal)
Mechanical Design/DFM: 2 years exposure (3+ years hands-on ideal)
CAD Proficiency: 2 years (CATIA/NX proficient ideal)
GD&T Awareness: Basic exposure (1+ year application ideal)
Drawing Review: 1 year (2+ years systematic reviewer ideal)
Industry: Manufacturing (Automotive/CV/Tactical vehicles preferred)

COMPENSATION
Competitive as per industry standards, commensurate with the value you bring. Fixed Pay, Performance Pay, and ESOP available. ESOP allocation at entry-level is lower but with strong growth trajectory. Performance and contribution lead to additional grants.

PART XVI: 90-DAY PERFORMANCE VALIDATION PERIOD
Day 1-30 Onboarding
Understand A-THON platforms and products
Learn CAD environment and drawing standards
Meet DFM team and cross-functional colleagues
Complete basic training (GD&T, FMEA overview), shadow senior engineers
Day 31-60 Assisted Work
Complete first drawing review (supervised)
Perform first tolerance calculation (guided)
Participate in first DFMEA session
Update first set of drawings per redlines
Day 61-90 Increasing Independence
Complete drawing reviews with minimal supervision
Perform basic tolerance calculations independently
Contribute to DFM documentation
Demonstrate consistent work quality

PART XVII: CAREER GROWTH PATH
The Junior DFM Engineer role is explicitly designed as a growth position with clear advancement paths.
SPECIALIST PATH (Growth through demonstrated competence, 2-3 years):
GD&T Specialist: Deep expertise in GD&T specification
Tolerance Stack-up Engineer: Deep expertise in stack-up analysis
DFMEA Lead: Deep expertise in FMEA methodology
GENERALIST PATH:
Senior DFM Engineer: Broader DFM expertise, more independence
DFM Lead: Leadership of DFM function (long-term)
Principal TE: Senior technical authority (long-term)
Growth Expectations:
Year 1: Complete basic tasks reliably, build foundational knowledge Confirmed as reliable contributor
Year 2: Increase independence, show emerging specialty interest Growth trajectory identified
Year 3: Demonstrate specialty competence, mentor newer team members Ready for mid-level role

PART XXI: THE JUNIOR ENGINEER'S COMMITMENT
If you have read this document, you understand the Junior DFM Engineer role at A-THON. You are the Translation Workforce that executes the detailed work of converting innovation into manufacturable products.
THE QUESTIONS YOU MAY WANT TO ASK YOURSELF
Am I genuinely willing to learn and grow rapidly?
Can I follow instructions carefully while building independent judgment?
Do I have the discipline to document my work thoroughly?
Am I comfortable asking questions when I don't understand?
Can I accept feedback and correction positively?
Am I reliable — will I deliver what I commit to?
Am I ready to be part of a team building something that didn't exist before?
In a market where nothing existed before, discovery must be protected from efficiency.
Your role is to execute the detailed work that translates innovation into reality.

Learn rapidly. Execute thoroughly. Grow continuously.
We are building India's "BEYOND ROADS" defence ground mobility future.

You're not joining a company — you're joining India's First Indigenous Tactical Vehicle Engineering Team. Be among "The First Creators" building platforms that serve Indian soldiers.

Engine Assembly & Durability Engineer (3W | CNG | Petrol | Flex-Fuel Engines)
Position Overview
We are looking for an Engine Assembly & Durability Engineer with strong hands-on expertise in 3W powertrains, especially CNG, Petrol, and Flex-Fuel engines. Perform engine assembly for 3W CNG, Petrol, and Flex-Fuel engines, ensuring accurate build as per drawings, torque sheets, and SOPs.
Execute durability tests on engine test beds and vehicles (endurance cycles, performance runs, over-load cycles).

Validate key durability aspects such as valve train wear, piston cylinder scuffing, crank bearing life, clutch durability, cooling efficiency, and NVH abnormalities.
Ensure compliance with relevant Bharat Stage (BS) emission norms and durability test requirements for CNG and Petrol engines.

Strong understanding of 3W powertrains, especially CNG, Petrol, and Flex-Fuel engine systems.
Expert hands-on capability in engine assembly, measurement tools, torque procedures, and critical clearances.
Good knowledge of engine combustion, CNG-specific behavior (knock tendencies, flame speed differences, fuel rail performance), and flex-fuel combustion variability.
Experience with engine dynamometers, test cycles, and durability instrumentation.
Proficiency in data analysis, including test data interpretation, statistical analysis, and visualization.
Understanding of failure mechanisms: valve seat recession, piston ring wear, connecting rod/bearing issues, thermal fatigue, lubrication failures, and CNG fuel system failures.
Ability to read engineering drawings, GD&T, and follow controlled assembly processes.
Strong documentation, communication, and problem-solving skills.
Education & Experience

title: Sr. Engineer,Aeroderivative Performance & Operability-Field Test Owner
description:
The Aeroderivative Performance & Operability Engineering team is a critical pillar within the Aeroderivative Engineering organization, operating at the intersection of engineering, commercial, and digital domains. The team covers project execution and model development for aspects related to performance (thermodynamic cycle models) and operability (including emissions, fuel flexibility, and controls). We are seeking a seasoned aeroderivative gas turbine expert who bridges world-class field testing with advanced cycle modeling. This role demands someone who can both troubleshoot units on-site and drive the quality of data that feeds our NPSS models??someone who understands that field test rigor directly impacts model accuracy. You will be the technical anchor for our OTR field activities, transforming how we collect, validate, and leverage field data to create increasingly precise steady-state and transient cycle models.This is a hands-on leadership role for an engineer who has mastered both the physics of aeroderivative gas turbines and the discipline of field testing. You will establish the standards for how we prepare for, execute, and extract value from every test. As a senior member of the team, you will be instrumental in training our early-career engineers, establishing best practices, and ensuring we deliver with the highest level of technical rigor on every project.
Roles and Responsibilities
Establish Rigorous Testing Standards & Protocols: Develop comprehensive procedures, calculation tools, and pretest readiness protocols that ensure data quality suitable for advanced cycle model validation. This includes instrument checkouts, sensor calibration verification, conditioning runs, and defining the critical data collection parameters needed for data reduction and model matching.
Lead Technical Test Preparation & Execution: Drive quality improvements into the test procedure, instrumentation plans, and pretest readiness process in commissioning to ensure data quality improves for cycle models, unit variation decreases, and execution quality is high. Serve as lead for field testing, performing real-time data quality assessment and troubleshooting performance issues using both field diagnostics and cycle model analysis.
Drive Data Quality for Cycle Model Development: Work with the cycle modeling team to ensure field data packages support NPSS steady-state and transient model validation. Execute data reduction and preliminary model matching in the field, applying gas turbine thermodynamic principles to interpret performance deviations and guide data collection strategies.
Mentor and Develop Team Capabilities: Take primary responsibility for developing junior engineers in both field procedures and underlying physics, teaching the connection between rigorous field data collection and accurate cycle modeling.
Coordinate & Improve: Serve as technical point of contact for third-party vendors, analyze past test results to identify improvements, and drive consistency in data collection and validation across all field operations.
Required Qualifications
This role requires significant experience in the Engineering/Technology & Performance Engineering. Knowledge level is comparable to a Master''s degree from an accredited university or college ( or a high school diploma with relevant experience).
Eligibility Requirements
Willingness and ability to travel up to 50% of the time.
Relocation to work in a hybrid model in Greenville, SC.
Desired Characteristics
Deep understanding of Aeroderivative gas turbine performance principles, data acquisition systems, and instrumentation.
Expertise in industry-standard performance test codes (e.g., ASME PTC 22, PTC 46).
A proven track record of writing technical procedures and developing engineering calculation tools from scratch.
Demonstrated experience in a formal or informal mentorship role, with a passion for teaching others.
Excellent communication and customer-facing skills, with the ability to clearly explain complex technical issues.
Strong analytical skills and proficiency with data analysis tools (NPSS, Python, etc.).

description:
We are seeking a highly analytical and detail-oriented Data Steward to support our global automotive operations team in driving efficiency, productivity, and data-informed decision-making across our automotive manufacturing and supply chain processes. This role is critical in ensuring the accuracy, consistency, and usability of operational data across production, logistics, inventory, and supplier systems. The ideal candidate will bridge the gap between data governance and day-to-day operations, enabling data-driven decision-making in a fast-paced, high-precision environment.
Your Team
This role will report to the Director, Operations Digitalization & Processes.
What You Will Do
Operational Data Quality:
Design, monitor and maintain high data quality checks and standards for production schedules, inventory levels, supplier records, and logistics data.
Master Data Management:
Oversee the creation, maintenance, and governance of master data related to parts, materials, suppliers, and production assets.
Process Optimization:
Collaborate with operations, supply chain, and IT teams to identify data-related inefficiencies and recommend improvements.
Data Governance Implementation:
Enforce data standards, naming conventions, and validation rules aligned with industry best practices and internal policies.
Root Cause Analysis:
Investigate data discrepancies and work with cross-functional teams to resolve issues at the source.
Documentation:
Maintain clear documentation of data flows, business rules, and data ownership across operational systems (e.g., ERP, MES, WMS).
Data Analysis:
Analyze large datasets from ERP, MES, and logistics systems to identify trends, inefficiencies, and opportunities for improvement.
Reporting:
Report out data quality statistics and quality issues to data entry/ domain owners and other relevant stakeholders.

title: Senior Specialist, IT Risk Analyst
description:
Role Overview:
We are seeking a proactive AI Risk Specialist with deep expertise in AI risk management, third-party risk assessments (TPRA), and application security/vulnerability management with data modelling and analytics expertise
In this pivotal role, you will deliver high-quality risk assessment services aligned with our IT and Cyber Risk standards. You will drive strategic planning and execution of AI-focused risk assessments, third-party/vendor risk reviews, and perform data analytics on Risk insights to support BIRO and leadership for ensuring timely, comprehensive, and compliant outcomes across our technology and business ecosystem.
What you will do:
AI focused Risk Assessments and Third-Party Vendor Risk Assessments (TPRA),
Data analysis and Risk insight from the assessment with clear reporting and ability to visualize & represent the Risk
Model the Threat attack path for Asset and capture the Risk
Mentor and guide team members, fostering continuous improvement, accountability, and adoption of AI risk best practices.
Risk Assessment Execution
Triage risk assessment requests and review inherent risk questionnaires, engaging relevant contacts across business and IT.
Validate completeness and accuracy of inherent risk inputs; advance engagements through appropriate AI risk and TPRA phases.
Analyze assessment responses, including AI model risks, data lineage, model governance, privacy, bias/fairness, robustness, and security controls.
Categorize findings using predefined company guidance; document outcomes, rationale, and recommended treatments clearly and consistently.
Identify and escalate High-risk issues (e.g., AI model vulnerabilities, insecure integrations, third-party control gaps) to Risk Treatment teams.
Track remediation plans and milestones, ensuring timely resolution and verifiable risk reduction.
Represent the team in weekly governance meetings, document requests meticulously, and maintain the risk log.
Review and categorize documented requests, providing actionable insights and recommendations for AI risk, TPRA, and application security reviews.
What you should have:
Extensive experience in AI Risk Management (e.g., model risk governance, responsible AI, bias/fairness, explainability, robustness), third-party risk (TPRA), and application security/vulnerability management.
Strong analytical and collaborative Data-analytics skills, data interpretation and modelling, ability to interpret complex technical and risk data and translate into clear, pragmatic Risk insights.
Excellent communication and interpersonal skills; comfortable engaging engineers, data scientists, product owners, and business stakeholders.
Adequate knowledge of understanding risk frameworks and methodologies (e.g., NIST AI RMF, ISO/IEC 23894 for AI, NIST CSF, ISO 27001/27036, SOC 2, OWASP ASVS, OWASP Top 10, CVSS).
Experience with risk tooling and processes (e.g., GRC platforms, TPRA tools, vulnerability management systems, SBOM/secure supply chain practices).
Domain experience in regulated environments (pharmaceutical, healthcare, or similarly regulated sectors) is highly preferred.

Positioned at the center of the travel, we shape the future by offering innovative advancements that pave the way for a more connected and seamless ecosystem as we power mobile apps, online travel sites, airline and hotel reservation networks, travel agent terminals, and scores of other solutions.
Simply put, we connect people with moments that matter.
DATA SCIENCE ENGINEER
Airline industry is going through a drastic transformation in the area of retailing and distribution that requires very advance data analytics support to optimize revenue performance and customer experience. Recently introduced concepts of Offer/Order Management and Continuous Dynamic Pricing significantly expand opportunities for engaging with travelers through multiple touch points and creating personalized offers accounting for individual preferences and market context. These practices can substantially benefit from a combination of statistical and machine learning techniques leveraging huge volumes and variety of consumer and competitive data available in airline industry.
The Data Science Engineer applies expert level statistical analysis, data modeling, and predictive analysis on strategic and operational problems in airline industry. As a key member of the Sabre Operations Research team, you will leverage your statistical and business expertise to translate business questions into data analysis and models, define suitable KPIs, and graphically present results to a wide range of audiences including internal and external clients, sales, and development team. In addition, you will source data from multiple different data sources, write high-quality data manipulation scripts in R, Python, Perl, bash, etc, develop and apply data mining and machine learning algorithms for advanced analysis and prediction. You will also utilize your strong communication skills to work with developers to support product development cycles and decision makers who need empirical data to promote sales and growth.
Responsibilities
Work with subject matter experts from airlines to identify opportunities for leveraging data to deliver insights and actionable prediction of customer behavior and operations performance.
Assess the effectiveness and accuracy of new data sources, data gathering and forecasting techniques.
Develop custom data models and algorithms to apply to data sets and run proof of concept studies.
Leverage existing Statistical and Machine Learning tools to enhance in-house algorithms.
Collaborate with software engineers to implement and test production quality code for forecasting and data analytics models.
Develop processes and tools to monitor and analyze data accuracy and models performance.
Demonstrate software to customers and perform value proving benchmarks. Calibrate software for customer needs and train customer for using and maintaining software.
Resolve customer complaints with software and respond to suggestions for improvements and enhancements.
Required Qualifications
Advanced Degree in Statistics, Operations Research, Computer Science, Mathematics, Machine Learning or related Quantitative disciplines.
Proven ability to apply modeling and analytical skills to real-world problems.
Knowledge of a variety of machine learning techniques (clustering, decision tree learning, artificial neural networks, etc.) and their real-world advantages/drawbacks.
Knowledge of advanced statistical techniques and concepts (regression, properties of distributions, statistical tests and proper usage, etc.) and experience with applications.
Solid programming skills with knowledge of SQL, Python, PySpark or other data-extraction and analysis tools and programming languages golang (preferred), Java, JavaScript or C++.
Experience with deployment of machine learning and statistical models on a cloud and leveraging services like Amazon SageMaker and Amazon Forecast.
Desirable Qualifications
Familiarity with airline, hospitality or retailing industries and decision support systems employed there.
Experience developing customer choice models, price elasticity estimation and market potential estimation.
Understanding of airline distribution, pricing, revenue management, NDC and Offer/Order Management concepts.

Job Description Summary
Job Description
Sr Data Engineer

Company:** Becton, Dickinson and Company (BD)

---

Job Summary

As a Sr Data Engineer at BD, you will be instrumental in designing, building, and maintaining robust and scalable data pipelines and infrastructure. You will apply your expertise to extract, transform, and load critical data from various sources, ensuring high data quality and accessibility for analytics, reporting, and machine learning initiatives across the organization.

---

Job Responsibilities

* Design, develop, and optimize scalable data pipelines (batch and real-time) using various data processing technologies to support analytical and operational needs.
* Implement and maintain data warehousing and data lake solutions, ensuring data integrity, security, and performance.
* Collaborate with data scientists, analysts, and other engineering teams to understand data requirements and translate them into technical specifications.
* Develop and implement data governance standards, including data quality checks, metadata management, and data lineage tracking.
* Monitor and fix data pipeline performance, identify bottlenecks, and implement solutions for continuous improvement.
* Evaluate and recommend new data technologies and tools to enhance BDs data platform capabilities.
* Automate data-related processes, including data ingestion, transformation, and validation.
* Participate in code reviews, provide technical guidance, and mentor junior engineers.
* Ensure compliance with data privacy regulations and internal security policies.

---

Job Qualifications

* Bachelors or Masters degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, or a related technical field.
* +7 years of proven experience in data engineering, with a strong focus on building and maintaining large-scale data platforms.
* Proficiency in at least one major programming language (e.g., Python, Java, Scala) and strong SQL skills.
* Extensive experience with cloud data platforms (e.g., AWS, Azure, GCP) and their relevant data services (e.g., S3, Redshift, Snowflake, Databricks, Azure Data Lake, BigQuery).
* Demonstrated experience with ETL/ELT tools and techniques, and data orchestration platforms (e.g., Airflow, Azure Data Factory).
* Solid understanding of data warehousing concepts, dimensional modeling, and data lake architectures.
* Experience with large-scale data processing technologies such as Spark, or Kafka.
* Familiarity with data governance principles, data quality frameworks, and metadata management.
* Excellent problem-solving skills, with the ability to analyze complex data issues and propose effective solutions.
* Strong communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively in multi-functional teams.
* Experience with version control systems (e.g., Git) and CI/CD pipelines.
